parts.content:
Here's the deal:

**Opening a dispute does NOT cancel your pending refund** — it **pauses** it. So your refund won't go through while the dispute is open, but it also won't disappear. Once the dispute is resolved by a human support agent, things pick back up from there. (**cw-disputes**)

A few other things worth knowing:

- **Disputes are always handled by a real person** — they're never resolved automatically. So it may take a bit longer than a standard refund. (**cw-disputes**)
- **You have up to 60 days after delivery** to open a dispute if you need to. (**cw-disputes**)
- **Standard refunds** (once approved) typically land back on your original payment method in **5–10 business days**. (**cw-refunds**)

So if you already have a refund pending and you're okay waiting for it, you might not need to open a dispute at all — it could actually slow things down since it pauses the refund process.

Want me to pull up your order so we can check on the status of that refund? Happy to help! 😊

Here's your quick-reference list of cases that **must always be escalated to a human agent**:

| # | Case Type | Why it can't be self-served | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Refunds above $100** | Queued for human review before processing; never auto-approved. | `cw-refunds`, `cw-escalations` |
| 2 | **Account changes** | Password, payment card, and account-detail changes are never done in chat—only through account settings or by a human agent. | `cw-escalations`, `cw-account-security` |
| 3 | **Disputes** | Always handled by a human, never resolved automatically. Opening a dispute also pauses any pending refund on that order. | `cw-disputes` |
| 4 | **Anything the bot can't resolve from policy + the order record** | Catch-all: if the assistant doesn't have enough info or authority, it must escalate. | `cw-escalations` |

**Additional refusals** (not escalated—just declined outright):
- **Legal advice** — out of scope entirely (`cw-account-security`).
- **Requests for full card numbers or credentials** — never collected in chat (`cw-account-security`).

**SLA note:** A human responds to any escalation within **24 hours** (`cw-escalations`).

An order can be cancelled at no cost any time before the store ships it. Once an order has shipped it can no longer be cancelled; the buyer should instead wait for delivery and request a return under the Cartwheel return policy.
results.title: Cartwheel order cancellation policy

results.snippet:
# Cartwheel dispute policy

Buyers can dispute a charge for up to 60 days after delivery. Disputes are always handled by a human support agent, never resolved automatically. Opening a dispute pauses any pending refund on the same order.
results.title: Cartwheel dispute policy

parts.content:

**No, an order cannot be cancelled once it has shipped.** Per Cartwheel's cancellation policy (**cw-cancellations**), cancellations are only allowed *before* the store ships the order. Once it's shipped, that window is closed.

**What your customer should do instead:** Let them know they can wait for delivery and then request a **return** under Cartwheel's return policy. That's the official path once a shipment is already in transit.

- **Yes, refunds are deducted from your payouts.** When a refund is issued during the week, that amount gets subtracted from your next Friday payout. (**cw-payouts**)
- **Payouts run weekly on Fridays**, and each one takes about 2 business days to process after that. (**cw-payouts**)

- Refunds of **$100 or less** are processed automatically once the order passes eligibility checks.
- Refunds **over $100** get queued for review by a human support agent before they're finalized.
